author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at SEGA and their mishandling of one of the best franchises under their belt. Yakuza Kiwami 3 is set to release soon and it might be one of the most mishandled and drama ridden releases from the company, and for good reason. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: I'm So Disappointed...
